app.description: Adobe Fonts is a web-based service providing access to a vast library of high-quality fonts for web and print design.
Microsoft 365 is a line of subscription services offered by Microsoft as part of the Microsoft Office product line.
Afterpay is a 'buy now, pay later' platform that makes it possible to pay off purchased goods in fortnightly instalments.
Squarespace provides Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) for website building and hosting, and allows users to use pre-built website templates.
Marko is HTML re-imagined as a language for building dynamic and reactive user interfaces.
core-js is a modular standard library for JavaScript, with polyfills for cutting-edge ECMAScript features.
Typekit is an online service which offers a subscription library of fonts.
Trident AB is a platform for optimizing websites through A/B testing.
Squarespace Commerce is an ecommerce platform designed to facilitate the creation of websites and online stores, with domain registration and web hosting included.

Anthropic is an AI safety company that develops Claude, a family of large language models, and provides an API for building AI-powered applications. The anthropic-domain-verification TXT record confirms domain ownership for Anthropic services.
jQuery is a JavaScript library which is a free, open-source software designed to simplify HTML DOM tree traversal and manipulation, as well as event handling, CSS animation, and Ajax.
Bitmovin is a platform that enables live and on-demand video workflows, supporting video processing, delivery, and playback across different streaming environments.

Wix provides cloud-based web development services, allowing users to create HTML5 websites and mobile sites.
Lodash is a JavaScript library which provides utility functions for common programming tasks using the functional programming paradigm.
The web-vitals JavaScript is a tiny, modular library for measuring all the web vitals metrics on real users.
